about: One minute of one electrode from each recording listed here, exactly as stored: uint16 ADC counts, little-endian, `fs` samples a second, microvolts = count x `uv_per_count`. The file starts `lead` samples before the minute and ends `lead` samples after it; those are there for the band filters to settle on and are not drawn. Written by music/eeg/extract.py; drawn by music/swim.js. Every other part of every recording stays with the person who made it.
